slides.texte_overlay:
rules i follow so i never
run out of things to say

ask about the story

i never ask what someone does, i ask how they ended up doing it. a job is just a fact, but the path to it is a story, and people love telling stories.

follow the energy

when someone's voice changes on a topic, i stay on that topic. people light up about one or two things, and finding them makes any conversation flow easily.

always have a fact

i learn one surprising fact a day so i always have something interesting to bring up. one good fact can carry a whole conversation when things go quiet.
slides.texte_sophia:
always have a fact

i learn one surprising fact every day in 5 minutes: octopuses, ancient rome, the moon. i do it with the Sophia app, and i never run out of interesting things to say.

slides.texte_overlay:
share something small

i share one small, honest thing about myself early on. it invites the other person to do the same, and the conversation becomes real much faster than usual.

let silence happen

i let short silences happen without panicking. a pause gives both people time to think, and what comes next is usually more honest and more interesting.
